== Objectives ==
Speak to Artahla Starstrider in Thunder Bluff.

== Description ==
Your journey has been adventurous so far. A wonderful thing to behold. But now you need to return to Thunder Bluff. Artahla Starstrider wishes to see you, to further the teachings of the Celestial Siblings. She awaits on the Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff.

== Completion ==
Good to see you. Let us not waste any more time.
